archive.catalogue_description: Clinic of Evil (Original idea based on a real urban exploration) In the summer of 2015 I went in an urbex with a lot of friends. So I thought why not make a map like this based on a sanatorium. This map has many features: – Mob of the Dead Style environment – Variety of weapons (BO2, AW, Custom) – Gondola – Acid Gat – Brutus – Shield – EE – Endgame – And much more… Credit: Treyarch (CodWaw mod tools) IZaRTaX (map,level documentation,level design,game design,scripts,fx’s,sound,textures,models,lights) RDV (elevator,gondola,character zombies,acidkit,shield,hud,Pause Menu,brutus,hintstrig,scripts) ElTitoPricus (weapons,character players,character sound) Andy Whelan (photoshop template) Harry Bo21 (shield, electric cherry,hintstrig) DidUknowiPwn (t6 hud) DuaLVII (rotating doors,zmb spawn system) Tom_BMX (tools) Wollowizzy (beta tester)

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 1 executable(s): Clinic Of Evil.exe. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). No finish found by name. Before accepting Round 20, someone should glance at this map's own triggers: acid_gat_build_trig, acidgat_pick_trigg, activ_trap, amb_citadel, amb_g1, area_grotte, area_killer, avion_trig, blood_place, blood_place_w, blood_trig, bonus.  DEDI 2026-09-22 (run map05, after the mount fix): the map now LOADS and spawns a server (`------ Server Initialization ------ / Server: sanatorium`), then dies with a GSC runtime error and the server shuts down. `undefined is not an array, string, or vector` at `common_scripts/utility.gsc:463 while( !level.flag[ msg ] )` -- the same flag_wait-before-flag_init shape as MW2 Rust and Project Viking. `level.flag` is created by `maps/_load.gsc:97`'s `flag_init("all_players_connected")`, so a map-provided script is flag_waiting before `_load::main()` has run. NOT ours: we mount no overlay (fs_game is the map's own mod, the referee is C++ and ships nothing inside it), the console shows `Loading fastfile 'mod'` and the map fastfile loading, and Der Berg answers getstatus with the same mount. Why the same script survives on a listen server is NOT established. dedi.md 13.3, referee.md 10. DEDI/REFEREE 2026-09-22 (runs mapA/mapB/mapC, join80-join83): THE 'broken' VERDICT IS CONFIRMED AND THE BLAME IS CORRECTED. The previous session left open whether our dedicated server, a referee GSC overlay or the replay sampler was the shared cause. It is none of them, and that was settled by running the maps with ours REMOVED rather than by reading code. dedi.md 14, referee.md 11. Run mapA booted this map on a STOCK CoDWaW.exe -- binkw32 proxy reverted, ZERO ENW code in the process -- as a LISTEN server, and it produced the byte-identical script runtime error. The cause is the map's own script order: main() starts a flag-dependent thread BEFORE it calls maps\_zombiemode::main(), which is what calls maps\_load::main(), which is where flag_init("all_players_connected") lives. A GSC `thread` begins executing immediately and flag_wait's first act is to index level.flag, so it faults before anything can have created the array. WHY THE COMMUNITY PLAYS IT ANYWAY IS NOT ESTABLISHED, and is written down as unestablished; the likeliest answer is that the archived download is a repack. Nothing in this lane can fix it. status stays "broken". maps/sanatorium.gsc line 21 calls maps\_zombiemode_rotating_door::init() from main() at line 19 -- the top of main(), long before _zombiemode::main() -- and rotating_door_init reads level.flag[self.script_flag] at line 34.  ARCHIVE 2026-09-23 (runs addon5 baseline / addon6 / addon7, dedicated, seeded private localappdata): THE ADD-ON-IWD THEORY IS TESTED AND DEAD. Run addon6, all five empty iwds excluded: the SAME `maps/_zombiemode_rotating_door.gsc:34` fault on level.flag. The map's own sanatorium.iwd carries only 5 scripts and none of them is rotating_door, so that script comes from the author's mod.ff. Not an add-on. dedi.md 15.
